verses.original: Καὶ ἐξελθὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀπὸ τοῦ ἱεροῦ ἐπορεύετο καὶ προσῆλθον οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπιδεῖξαι αὐτῷ τὰς οἰκοδομὰς τοῦ ἱεροῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai exelthōn ho Iēsous apo tou hierou eporeueto kai prosēlthon hoi mathētai autou epideixai autō tas oikodomas tou hierou
verses.literal: As Jesus left . . . the temple and was walking away His disciples came up to Him to point out - its buildings
verses.literalPt: Tendo saído Jesus do templo, ia-se retirando, quando se chegaram a ele seus discípulos para lhe mostrarem os edifícios do templo.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Οὐ βλέπετε ταῦτα πάντα ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν οὐ μὴ ἀφεθῇ ὧδε λίθος ἐπὶ λίθον ὃς οὐ καταλυθήσεται
verses.transliteration: ho de apokritheis eipen autois Ou blepete tauta panta amēn legō hymin ou mē aphethē hōde lithos epi lithon hos ou katalythēsetai
verses.literal: Do you see all these things He replied . . . Truly I tell you not one stone here will be left on another every one . . . will be thrown down
verses.literalPt: Mas ele lhes disse: Vedes tudo isto? Em verdade vos digo que não ficará aqui pedra sobre pedra que não seja derribada.

verses.original: Καθημένου δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τοῦ ὄρους τῶν Ἐλαιῶν προσῆλθον αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ κατ’ ἰδίαν λέγοντες Εἰπὲ ἡμῖν πότε ταῦτα ἔσται καὶ τί τὸ σημεῖον τῆς σῆς παρουσίας καὶ συντελείας τοῦ αἰῶνος
verses.transliteration: Kathēmenou de autou epi tou orous tōn Elaiōn prosēlthon autō hoi mathētai kat’ idian legontes Eipe hēmin pote tauta estai kai ti to sēmeion tēs sēs parousias kai synteleias tou aiōnos
verses.literal: While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives the disciples came to Him privately Tell us they said when will these things happen and what will be the sign of Your coming and of the end of the age
verses.literalPt: Estando ele sentado no monte das Oliveiras, chegaram seus discípulos em particular, dizendo-lhe: Declara-nos quando sucederão essas coisas e qual o sinal da tua vinda e do fim do mundo?

verses.original: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Βλέπετε μή τις ὑμᾶς πλανήσῃ
verses.transliteration: Kai apokritheis ho Iēsous eipen autois Blepete mē tis hymas planēsē
verses.literal: Jesus answered . . . . . . See to it that no one . . . deceives you
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Jesus: Vede que ninguém vos engane.

verses.original: πολλοὶ γὰρ ἐλεύσονται ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου λέγοντες Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ Χριστός καὶ πολλοὺς πλανήσουσιν
verses.transliteration: polloi gar eleusontai epi tō onomati mou legontes Egō eimi ho Christos kai pollous planēsousin
verses.literal: For many will come in My name claiming I am the Christ and will deceive many . . .
verses.literalPt: Pois muitos virão em meu nome, dizendo: Eu sou o Cristo, e enganarão a muitos.

verses.original: μελλήσετε δὲ ἀκούειν πολέμους καὶ ἀκοὰς πολέμων ὁρᾶτε μὴ θροεῖσθε δεῖ γὰρ γενέσθαι ἀλλ’ οὔπω ἐστὶν τὸ τέλος
verses.transliteration: mellēsete de akouein polemous kai akoas polemōn horate mē throeisthe dei gar genesthai all’ oupō estin to telos
verses.literal: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars but see to it that you are not alarmed These things must happen but the end is still to come
verses.literalPt: Haveis de ouvir falar de guerras e rumores de guerras; olhai, não vos assusteis; porque é necessário que assim aconteça, mas não é ainda o fim.

verses.original: ἐγερθήσεται γὰρ ἔθνος ἐπὶ ἔθνος καὶ βασιλεία ἐπὶ βασιλείαν καὶ ἔσονται λιμοὶ καὶ σεισμοὶ κατὰ τόπους
verses.transliteration: egerthēsetai gar ethnos epi ethnos kai basileia epi basileian kai esontai limoi kai seismoi kata topous
verses.literal: Nation will rise against nation and kingdom against kingdom There will be famines and earthquakes in various places
verses.literalPt: Pois se levantará nação contra nação, reino contra reino, e haverá fomes e terremotos em diversos lugares;

verses.original: πάντα δὲ ταῦτα ἀρχὴ ὠδίνων
verses.transliteration: panta de tauta archē ōdinōn
verses.literal: All these are the beginning of birth pains
verses.literalPt: porém tudo isso é o princípio das dores.

verses.original: Τότε παραδώσουσιν ὑμᾶς εἰς θλῖψιν καὶ ἀποκτενοῦσιν ὑμᾶς καὶ ἔσεσθε μισούμενοι ὑπὸ πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν διὰ τὸ ὄνομά μου
verses.transliteration: Tote paradōsousin hymas eis thlipsin kai apoktenousin hymas kai esesthe misoumenoi hypo pantōn tōn ethnōn dia to onoma mou
verses.literal: Then they will deliver you over to be persecuted and killed . . . and you will be hated by all nations because of My name
verses.literalPt: Então, sereis entregues à tribulação, e vos matarão; sereis odiados por todas as nações por causa do meu nome.

verses.original: καὶ τότε σκανδαλισθήσονται πολλοὶ καὶ ἀλλήλους παραδώσουσιν καὶ μισήσουσιν ἀλλήλους
verses.transliteration: kai tote skandalisthēsontai polloi kai allēlous paradōsousin kai misēsousin allēlous
verses.literal: At that time many will fall away and will betray and hate one another
verses.literalPt: Nesse tempo, muitos hão de se escandalizar e trair-se uns aos outros, e uns aos outros se odiarão;

verses.original: καὶ πολλοὶ ψευδοπροφῆται ἐγερθήσονται καὶ πλανήσουσιν πολλούς
verses.transliteration: kai polloi pseudoprophētai egerthēsontai kai planēsousin pollous
verses.literal: and many false prophets will arise and deceive many
verses.literalPt: hão de se levantar muitos falsos profetas e a muitos enganarão;

verses.original: Καὶ διὰ τὸ πληθυνθῆναι τὴν ἀνομίαν ψυγήσεται ἡ ἀγάπη τῶν πολλῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai dia to plēthynthēnai tēn anomian psygēsetai hē agapē tōn pollōn
verses.literal: Because of the multiplication of wickedness the love of most will grow cold
verses.literalPt: e, por se multiplicar a iniquidade, resfriar-se-á o amor da maior parte dos homens.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ὑπομείνας εἰς τέλος οὗτος σωθήσεται
verses.transliteration: ho de hypomeinas eis telos houtos sōthēsetai
verses.literal: But the one who perseveres to the end will be saved
verses.literalPt: Todavia, quem persevera até o fim, esse será salvo.

verses.original: Καὶ κηρυχθήσεται τοῦτο τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς βασιλείας ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ οἰκουμένῃ εἰς μαρτύριον πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ τότε ἥξει τὸ τέλος
verses.transliteration: Kai kērychthēsetai touto to euangelion tēs basileias en holē tē oikoumenē eis martyrion pasin tois ethnesin kai tote hēxei to telos
verses.literal: And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in all the world as a testimony to all nations and then the end will come
verses.literalPt: Será pregado este evangelho do reino por todo o mundo em testemunho a todas as nações, e então virá o fim.

verses.original: Ὅταν οὖν ἴδητε Τὸ βδέλυγμα τῆς ἐρημώσεως τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Δανιὴλ τοῦ προφήτου ἑστὸς ἐν τόπῳ ἁγίῳ ὁ ἀναγινώσκων νοείτω
verses.transliteration: Hotan oun idēte To bdelygma tēs erēmōseōs to rhēthen dia Daniēl tou prophētou hestos en topō hagiō ho anaginōskōn noeitō
verses.literal: So when you see standing in the holy place the abomination of desolation spoken of by the prophet Daniel (let the reader understand)
verses.literalPt: Quando, pois, virdes a abominação de desolação, predita pelo profeta Daniel, estabelecida no lugar santo ( quem lê, entenda),

verses.original: τότε οἱ ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ φευγέτωσαν εἰς τὰ ὄρη
verses.transliteration: tote hoi en tē Ioudaia pheugetōsan eis ta orē
verses.literal: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains
verses.literalPt: então os que estiverem na Judeia fujam para os montes;

verses.original: ὁ ἐπὶ τοῦ δώματος μὴ καταβάτω ἆραι τὰ ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: ho epi tou dōmatos mē katabatō arai ta ek tēs oikias autou
verses.literal: Let no one on the housetop come down to retrieve anything from his house
verses.literalPt: o que se achar no eirado não desça a tirar as coisas de sua casa,

verses.original: καὶ ὁ ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ μὴ ἐπιστρεψάτω ὀπίσω ἆραι τὸ ἱμάτιον αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai ho en tō agrō mē epistrepsatō opisō arai to himation autou
verses.literal: And let no one in the field return . . . for his cloak
verses.literalPt: e o que estiver no campo, não volte para tomar a sua capa.

verses.original: Οὐαὶ δὲ ταῖς ἐν γαστρὶ ἐχούσαις καὶ ταῖς θηλαζούσαις ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις
verses.transliteration: Ouai de tais en gastri echousais kai tais thēlazousais en ekeinais tais hēmerais
verses.literal: How miserable those days will be for pregnant . . . . . . and nursing mothers
verses.literalPt: Mas ai das que estiverem grávidas e das que amamentarem naqueles dias!

verses.original: προσεύχεσθε δὲ ἵνα μὴ γένηται ἡ φυγὴ ὑμῶν χειμῶνος μηδὲ σαββάτῳ
verses.transliteration: proseuchesthe de hina mē genētai hē phygē hymōn cheimōnos mēde sabbatō
verses.literal: Pray that your flight will not occur in the winter or on the Sabbath
verses.literalPt: Rogai que a vossa fuga não suceda no inverno, nem no sábado;

verses.original: ἔσται γὰρ τότε θλῖψις μεγάλη οἵα οὐ γέγονεν ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς κόσμου ἕως τοῦ νῦν οὐδ’ οὐ μὴ γένηται
verses.transliteration: estai gar tote thlipsis megalē hoia ou gegonen ap’ archēs kosmou heōs tou nyn oud’ ou mē genētai
verses.literal: For at that time there will be great tribulation unseen . . . . . . from the beginning of the world until now and never to be seen again
verses.literalPt: porque haverá então grande tribulação, tal como nunca houve desde o princípio do mundo até agora, nem haverá jamais.

verses.original: καὶ εἰ μὴ ἐκολοβώθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι ἐκεῖναι οὐκ ἂν ἐσώθη πᾶσα σάρξ διὰ δὲ τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς κολοβωθήσονται αἱ ἡμέραι ἐκεῖναι
verses.transliteration: kai ei mē ekolobōthēsan hai hēmerai ekeinai ouk an esōthē pasa sarx dia de tous eklektous kolobōthēsontai hai hēmerai ekeinai
verses.literal: If . . . those days had not been cut short . . . nobody . . . would be saved But for the sake of the elect those days will be cut short
verses.literalPt: Se não se abreviassem aqueles dias, ninguém seria salvo; mas, por amor dos escolhidos, esses dias serão abreviados.

verses.original: Τότε ἐάν τις ὑμῖν εἴπῃ Ἰδοὺ ὧδε ὁ Χριστός ἤ Ὧδε μὴ πιστεύσητε
verses.transliteration: Tote ean tis hymin eipē Idou hōde ho Christos ē Hōde mē pisteusēte
verses.literal: At that time if anyone says to you Look here is the Christ or There He is do not believe it
verses.literalPt: Então se alguém vos disser: Eis aqui o Cristo! Ou: Ei-lo ali, não acrediteis;

verses.original: ἐγερθήσονται γὰρ ψευδόχριστοι καὶ ψευδοπροφῆται καὶ δώσουσιν σημεῖα μεγάλα καὶ τέρατα ὥστε πλανῆσαι εἰ δυνατὸν καὶ τοὺς ἐκλεκτούς
verses.transliteration: egerthēsontai gar pseudochristoi kai pseudoprophētai kai dōsousin sēmeia megala kai terata hōste planēsai ei dynaton kai tous eklektous
verses.literal: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders to deceive even the elect if that were possible
verses.literalPt: porque se hão de levantar falsos cristos e falsos profetas e mostrarão tais sinais e milagres que, se fora possível, enganariam até os escolhidos.

verses.original: ἰδοὺ προείρηκα ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: idou proeirēka hymin
verses.literal: See I have told you in advance . . .
verses.literalPt: Vede que de antemão vo-lo tenho declarado.

verses.original: Ἐὰν οὖν εἴπωσιν ὑμῖν Ἰδοὺ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἐστίν μὴ ἐξέλθητε Ἰδοὺ ἐν τοῖς ταμείοις μὴ πιστεύσητε
verses.transliteration: Ean oun eipōsin hymin Idou en tē erēmō estin mē exelthēte Idou en tois tameiois mē pisteusēte
verses.literal: So if they tell you There He is in the wilderness do not go out or, ‘Here He is, in the inner rooms do not believe it
verses.literalPt: Se, pois, vos disserem: Ei-lo que está no deserto!, não saiais. Ou: Ei-lo no interior da casa!, não acrediteis;

verses.original: ὥσπερ γὰρ ἡ ἀστραπὴ ἐξέρχεται ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν καὶ φαίνεται ἕως δυσμῶν οὕτως ἔσται ἡ παρουσία τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου
verses.transliteration: hōsper gar hē astrapē exerchetai apo anatolōn kai phainetai heōs dysmōn houtōs estai hē parousia tou Huiou tou anthrōpou
verses.literal: For just as the lightning comes from the east and flashes as far as the west so will be the coming of the Son of Man
verses.literalPt: porque, assim como o relâmpago sai do Oriente e se mostra até o Ocidente, assim será a vinda do Filho do Homem.

verses.original: ὅπου ἐὰν ᾖ τὸ πτῶμα ἐκεῖ συναχθήσονται οἱ ἀετοί
verses.transliteration: hopou ean ē to ptōma ekei synachthēsontai hoi aetoi
verses.literal: Wherever . . . there is a carcass there the vultures will gather
verses.literalPt: Onde estiver o cadáver, aí se juntarão os corvos.

verses.original: Εὐθέως δὲ μετὰ τὴν θλῖψιν τῶν ἡμερῶν ἐκείνων Ὁ ἥλιος σκοτισθήσεται Καὶ ἡ σελήνη οὐ δώσει τὸ φέγγος αὐτῆς Καὶ οἱ ἀστέρες πεσοῦνται ἀπὸ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ Καὶ αἱ δυνάμεις τῶν οὐρανῶν σαλευθήσονται
verses.transliteration: Eutheōs de meta tēn thlipsin tōn hēmerōn ekeinōn Ho hēlios skotisthēsetai Kai hē selēnē ou dōsei to phengos autēs Kai hoi asteres pesountai apo tou ouranou Kai hai dynameis tōn ouranōn saleuthēsontai
verses.literal: Immediately after the tribulation of those days The sun will be darkened and the moon will not give its light the stars will fall from the sky and the powers of the heavens will be shaken
verses.literalPt: Logo depois da tribulação daqueles dias, o sol escurecerá, a lua não dará a sua claridade, as estrelas cairão do céu, e as potestades dos céus serão abaladas.

verses.original: Καὶ τότε φανήσεται τὸ σημεῖον τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ τότε κόψονται πᾶσαι αἱ φυλαὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ὄψονται τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐρχόμενον ἐπὶ τῶν νεφελῶν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ μετὰ δυνάμεως καὶ δόξης πολλῆς
verses.transliteration: Kai tote phanēsetai to sēmeion tou Huiou tou anthrōpou en tō ouranō kai tote kopsontai pasai hai phylai tēs gēs kai opsontai ton Huion tou anthrōpou erchomenon epi tōn nephelōn tou ouranou meta dynameōs kai doxēs pollēs
verses.literal: At that time the sign of the Son of Man will appear in heaven and . . . all the tribes of the earth will mourn They will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory
verses.literalPt: Então, aparecerá no céu o sinal do Filho do Homem, e todas as tribos da terra se hão de lamentar e verão o Filho do Homem vir sobre as nuvens do céu com poder e grande glória.

verses.original: καὶ ἀποστελεῖ τοὺς ἀγγέλους αὐτοῦ μετὰ σάλπιγγος μεγάλης καὶ ἐπισυνάξουσιν τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῶν τεσσάρων ἀνέμων ἀπ’ ἄκρων οὐρανῶν ἕως τῶν ἄκρων αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: kai apostelei tous angelous autou meta salpingos megalēs kai episynaxousin tous eklektous autou ek tōn tessarōn anemōn ap’ akrōn ouranōn heōs tōn akrōn autōn
verses.literal: And He will send out His angels with a loud trumpet call and they will gather His elect from the four winds from one end of the heavens to the other
verses.literalPt: Ele enviará os seus anjos com grande trombeta, os quais ajuntarão os escolhidos dos quatro ventos, de uma à outra extremidade dos céus.

verses.original: Ἀπὸ δὲ τῆς συκῆς μάθετε τὴν παραβολήν ὅταν ἤδη ὁ κλάδος αὐτῆς γένηται ἁπαλὸς καὶ τὰ φύλλα ἐκφύῃ γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐγγὺς τὸ θέρος
verses.transliteration: Apo de tēs sykēs mathete tēn parabolēn hotan ēdē ho klados autēs genētai hapalos kai ta phylla ekphyē ginōskete hoti engys to theros
verses.literal: Now learn this lesson from the fig tree As soon as . . . its branches become tender and sprout leaves you know that summer is near
verses.literalPt: Aprendei essa parábola tirada da figueira: quando os seus ramos já estiverem tenros e brotarem folhas, sabeis que está próximo o verão;

verses.original: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς ὅταν ἴδητε πάντα ταῦτα γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐγγύς ἐστιν ἐπὶ θύραις
verses.transliteration: houtōs kai hymeis hotan idēte panta tauta ginōskete hoti engys estin epi thyrais
verses.literal: So also when you see all these things you will know that He is near right at the door
verses.literalPt: assim também vós, quando virdes todas essas coisas, sabei que ele está próximo, às portas.

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐ μὴ παρέλθῃ ἡ γενεὰ αὕτη ἕως ἂν πάντα ταῦτα γένηται
verses.transliteration: amēn legō hymin hoti ou mē parelthē hē genea hautē heōs an panta tauta genētai
verses.literal: Truly I tell you this generation will not . . . pass away until . . . all these things have happened
verses.literalPt: Em verdade vos digo que não passará esta geração sem que todas essas coisas se cumpram.

verses.original: ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ παρελεύσεται οἱ δὲ λόγοι μου οὐ μὴ παρέλθωσιν
verses.transliteration: ho ouranos kai hē gē pareleusetai hoi de logoi mou ou mē parelthōsin
verses.literal: Heaven and earth will pass away but My words will never . . . pass away
verses.literalPt: Passará o céu e a terra, mas não passarão as minhas palavras.

verses.original: Περὶ δὲ τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης καὶ ὥρας οὐδεὶς οἶδεν οὐδὲ οἱ ἄγγελοι τῶν οὐρανῶν οὐδὲ ὁ Υἱός εἰ μὴ ὁ Πατὴρ μόνος
verses.transliteration: Peri de tēs hēmeras ekeinēs kai hōras oudeis oiden oude hoi angeloi tōn ouranōn oude ho Huios ei mē ho Patēr monos
verses.literal: No one knows about that day or hour not even the angels in heaven nor the Son but . . . only the Father
verses.literalPt: Mas daquele dia e daquela hora ninguém sabe, nem os anjos dos céus, nem o Filho, senão só o Pai.

verses.original: ὥσπερ γὰρ αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ Νῶε οὕτως ἔσται ἡ παρουσία τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου
verses.transliteration: hōsper gar hai hēmerai tou Nōe houtōs estai hē parousia tou Huiou tou anthrōpou
verses.literal: As it was in the days of Noah so will it be at the coming of the Son of Man
verses.literalPt: Pois assim como foi nos dias de Noé, assim será a vinda do Filho do Homem.

verses.original: ὡς γὰρ ἦσαν ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ταῖς πρὸ τοῦ κατακλυσμοῦ τρώγοντες καὶ πίνοντες γαμοῦντες καὶ γαμίζοντες ἄχρι ἧς ἡμέρας εἰσῆλθεν Νῶε εἰς τὴν κιβωτόν
verses.transliteration: hōs gar ēsan en tais hēmerais ekeinais tais pro tou kataklysmou trōgontes kai pinontes gamountes kai gamizontes achri hēs hēmeras eisēlthen Nōe eis tēn kibōton
verses.literal: For in the days before the flood people were eating and drinking marrying and giving in marriage up to the day Noah entered . . . the ark
verses.literalPt: Pois assim como naqueles dias antes do dilúvio comiam e bebiam, casavam-se e davam-se em casamento, até o dia em que Noé entrou na arca,

verses.original: καὶ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν ἕως ἦλθεν ὁ κατακλυσμὸς καὶ ἦρεν ἅπαντας οὕτως ἔσται καὶ ἡ παρουσία τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου
verses.transliteration: kai ouk egnōsan heōs ēlthen ho kataklysmos kai ēren hapantas houtōs estai kai hē parousia tou Huiou tou anthrōpou
verses.literal: And they were oblivious until the flood came and swept them all away . . . So will it be at the coming of the Son of Man
verses.literalPt: e não o perceberam senão quando veio o dilúvio e os levou a todos, assim será também a vinda do Filho do Homem.

verses.original: τότε ἔσονται δύο ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ εἷς παραλαμβάνεται καὶ εἷς ἀφίεται
verses.transliteration: tote esontai dyo en tō agrō heis paralambanetai kai heis aphietai
verses.literal: Two men will be in the field one will be taken and the other left
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, de dois homens que estiverem no campo, um será tomado, e o outro será deixado;

verses.original: δύο ἀλήθουσαι ἐν τῷ μύλῳ μία παραλαμβάνεται καὶ μία ἀφίεται
verses.transliteration: dyo alēthousai en tō mylō mia paralambanetai kai mia aphietai
verses.literal: Two women will be grinding at the mill one will be taken and the other left
verses.literalPt: de duas mulheres que estiverem moendo em um moinho, uma será tomada, e a outra será deixada.

verses.original: Γρηγορεῖτε οὖν ὅτι οὐκ οἴδατε ποίᾳ ἡμέρᾳ ὁ κύριος ὑμῶν ἔρχεται
verses.transliteration: Grēgoreite oun hoti ouk oidate poia hēmera ho kyrios hymōn erchetai
verses.literal: Therefore keep watch because you do not know the day on which your Lord will come
verses.literalPt: Portanto, vigiai, porque não sabeis em que dia vem o vosso Senhor;

verses.original: ἐκεῖνο δὲ γινώσκετε ὅτι εἰ ᾔδει ὁ οἰκοδεσπότης ποίᾳ φυλακῇ ὁ κλέπτης ἔρχεται ἐγρηγόρησεν ἂν καὶ οὐκ ἂν εἴασεν διορυχθῆναι τὴν οἰκίαν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: ekeino de ginōskete hoti ei ēdei ho oikodespotēs poia phylakē ho kleptēs erchetai egrēgorēsen an kai ouk an eiasen diorychthēnai tēn oikian autou
verses.literal: But understand this If the homeowner had known in which watch of the night the thief was coming he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into
verses.literalPt: mas considerai que, se o dono da casa tivesse sabido a que hora da noite havia de vir o ladrão, teria vigiado e não haveria deixado arrombar a sua casa.

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο καὶ ὑμεῖς γίνεσθε ἕτοιμοι ὅτι ᾗ οὐ δοκεῖτε ὥρᾳ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἔρχεται
verses.transliteration: dia touto kai hymeis ginesthe hetoimoi hoti hē ou dokeite hōra ho Huios tou anthrōpou erchetai
verses.literal: For this reason . . . you also must be ready because the Son of Man will come at an hour you do not expect
verses.literalPt: Por isso, estai vós também apercebidos; porque, à hora em que não pensais, virá o Filho do Homem.

verses.original: Τίς ἄρα ἐστὶν ὁ πιστὸς δοῦλος καὶ φρόνιμος ὃν κατέστησεν ὁ κύριος ἐπὶ τῆς οἰκετείας αὐτοῦ τοῦ δοῦναι αὐτοῖς τὴν τροφὴν ἐν καιρῷ
verses.transliteration: Tis ara estin ho pistos doulos kai phronimos hon katestēsen ho kyrios epi tēs oiketeias autou tou dounai autois tēn trophēn en kairō
verses.literal: Who then is the faithful and wise servant whom the master has put in charge of his household to give the others their food at the proper time
verses.literalPt: Quem é, pois, o servo fiel e prudente, ao qual o seu senhor confiou a direção da sua casa, para que, a tempo, dê a todos o sustento?

verses.original: μακάριος ὁ δοῦλος ἐκεῖνος ὃν ἐλθὼν ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ εὑρήσει οὕτως ποιοῦντα
verses.transliteration: makarios ho doulos ekeinos hon elthōn ho kyrios autou heurēsei houtōs poiounta
verses.literal: Blessed is that servant whose . . . master finds him doing so when he returns
verses.literalPt: Feliz aquele servo a quem o seu senhor, quando vier, achar assim fazendo.

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐπὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς ὑπάρχουσιν αὐτοῦ καταστήσει αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: amēn legō hymin hoti epi pasin tois hyparchousin autou katastēsei auton
verses.literal: Truly I tell you he will put him in charge . . . of all his possessions
verses.literalPt: Em verdade vos digo que lhe confiará todos os seus bens.

verses.original: Ἐὰν δὲ εἴπῃ ὁ κακὸς δοῦλος ἐκεῖνος ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ Χρονίζει μου ὁ κύριος
verses.transliteration: Ean de eipē ho kakos doulos ekeinos en tē kardia autou Chronizei mou ho kyrios
verses.literal: But suppose that servant is wicked and says in his heart My master will be away a long time
verses.literalPt: Mas, se aquele servo, sendo mau, disser no seu coração: Meu senhor demora-se,

verses.original: καὶ ἄρξηται τύπτειν τοὺς συνδούλους αὐτοῦ ἐσθίῃ δὲ καὶ πίνῃ μετὰ τῶν μεθυόντων
verses.transliteration: kai arxētai typtein tous syndoulous autou esthiē de kai pinē meta tōn methyontōn
verses.literal: And he begins to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards
verses.literalPt: e começar a espancar os seus companheiros, e a comer, e beber com os ébrios,

verses.original: ἥξει ὁ κύριος τοῦ δούλου ἐκείνου ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ οὐ προσδοκᾷ καὶ ἐν ὥρᾳ ᾗ οὐ γινώσκει
verses.transliteration: hēxei ho kyrios tou doulou ekeinou en hēmera hē ou prosdoka kai en hōra hē ou ginōskei
verses.literal: The master of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not anticipate
verses.literalPt: virá o senhor daquele servo no dia em que este o não espera e na hora que não sabe,

verses.original: καὶ διχοτομήσει αὐτὸν καὶ τὸ μέρος αὐτοῦ μετὰ τῶν ὑποκριτῶν θήσει ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων
verses.transliteration: kai dichotomēsei auton kai to meros autou meta tōn hypokritōn thēsei ekei estai ho klauthmos kai ho brygmos tōn odontōn
verses.literal: Then he will cut him to pieces . . . and assign him a place with the hypocrites where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth
verses.literalPt: e cortá-lo-á pelo meio, e pô-lo-á com os ímpios; ali haverá o choro e o ranger de dentes.
